detail.longDescription: Safari 27.2 (26 October) stopped VoiceOver from reading streamed text twice, on pages that update a live region by re-rendering it. People on older versions still hear the echo, so if your assistant swaps its whole message as tokens arrive, give it one listen on an older Safari. https:// webkit.org/blog/18515/webkit-f eatures-for-safari-27-2/ # a11y # Accessibility # WebDev # Safari
